context: Subscribers receive real-time price ticks from a shared EventEmitter-based feed. Each user session calls `subscribe()` when they open a watchlist.
explanation: Removing the stored handler reference and the returned cleanup function means `removeListener` can never be called. Every subscribe adds a new anonymous listener to the long-lived feed emitter — after enough sessions, Node warns about a memory leak and the process slows to a crawl. Fix: keep a reference to the handler and return a teardown function that calls `feed.removeListener`.
